title: Bilevel ZOFO: Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning and Meta-Training
abstract: arXiv:2502.03604v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fine-tuning pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs) for downstream tasks using First-Order (FO) optimizers presents significant computational challenges. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods address these by freezing most model parameters and training only a small subset. However, PEFT often underperforms compared to full fine-tuning when high task-specific accuracy is required. Zeroth-Order (ZO) methods fine-tune the entire pre-trained model without back-propagation, estimating gradients through forward passes only. While memory-efficient, ZO methods suffer from slow convergence and high sensitivity to prompt selection. We bridge these two worlds with Bilevel-ZOFO, a bilevel optimization method that couples fast, local FO-PEFT adaptation at the inner level with stable, memory-efficient ZO updates of the full backbone at the outer level. translated_title: 双层ZOFO：高效的大语言模型微调与元训练
translated_abstract: 使用一阶（FO）优化器对预训练大语言模型（LLM）进行下游任务微调面临着显著的计算挑战。参数高效微调（PEFT）方法通过冻结大部分模型参数、仅训练一小部分参数来应对这些挑战。然而，当需要较高的任务特定精度时，PEFT的表现往往不如全参数微调。零阶（ZO）方法无需反向传播即可微调整个预训练模型，仅通过前向传播来估计梯度。虽然内存效率高，但ZO方法存在收敛速度慢以及对提示选择高度敏感的问题。我们通过Bilevel-ZOFO将这两种方法结合起来，这是一种双层优化方法，在内层进行快速、局部的FO-PEFT自适应调整，在外层对整个骨干网络进行稳定且内存高效的ZO更新。FO-PEFT内循环执行快速、低内存的局部自适应，从而降低了方差
tldr: 提出双层优化方法Bilevel-ZOFO，在内层结合快速的FO-PEFT局部自适应调整，在外层结合内存高效的ZO全骨干网络更新，兼顾PEFT的速度优势与ZO方法的内存效率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Bilevel-ZOFO, a bilevel optimization method that couples fast local FO-PEFT adaptation at the inner level with stable, memory-efficient ZO updates of the full backbone at the outer level, combining the speed of PEFT with the memory efficiency of ZO methods.
